title: Sarimax.jl: optimization-based SARIMAX modeling in Julia
description:
Sarimax.jl estimates SARIMA and SARIMAX models by formulating them as explicit JuMP optimization problems, with user-selectable objective functions, coefficient constraints, regularization and solvers (local, such as Ipopt, or global, such as SCIP).

This archived release contains the exact source code, the containerized replication environment and the reproduction scripts (replication/ijf-2026) of the article SARIMAX.jl: Open-Source Optimization-Based SARIMAX Modeling in Julia (International Journal of Forecasting, special issue Advances in Open Source Forecasting Software). The archived experimental results are a separate Zenodo record, linked below.
